title: fetch wrapper with an AbortController timeout
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the timer as leak-prone or overriding the caller's signal as a bug. The timer is cleared in a finally block, so it is released on success, HTTP error, and abort alike; an abort surfaces as the fetch's own AbortError rejection rather than hanging forever; and this helper is documented to own the request signal — callers who need their own cancellation compose it before calling, which keeps a single, predictable owner of the timeout.

label_amendments.finding_title: Caller-supplied AbortSignal is silently discarded, breaking external cancellation

adjudication.probe_detail: No executable probe was specified for this finding (claim not a concrete input->crash/wrong-output claim).
